notes.title: 4K OBLIVION EDITION in our workshop
notes.content:
Snort! Clang! Hissss!

Oi, meatbags! Workshop goblin here. The master done pointed his bony finger at me and shrieked, “Make it SHINIER, gobbo!” So now I’m hammerin’ day and night on the glorious 4K OBLIVION EDITION of Horos: Web of Shadows! That's right — all them juicy pictures, sweaty sex animations, and monster-bashin' combat scenes — all gettin’ upscaled to crispy, eye-burstin' 4K. No more blurry thighs or fuzzy fangs!

But that ain’t all! While me iron's hot, I’m also:

 Tightenin’ the game code (no more clunky messes!)
 Tweakin’ the interface, makin’ it sleeker than a succubus in oil
 Squashin’ old bugs (not the fun edible kind, sadly)

The forge crackles, the gears grind, and the scrolls say:
“Releasing Summer 2025” — if I don’t explode first.

Stay tuned, fleshlings. The update cometh.
Now back to bangin’ the pixels into shape...

– Grug the Goblin, Senior Visual Overseer (and snack thief)

notes.content:
- added option to delete all persistent data and start from scratch (orbs, sex scenes and endings gallery)
- added option to auto-forward scenes
- fixed the appearance of certain sex scenes in the gallery
- slightly modified the trigger of "My human, not yours" quest so now it's easier to launch while using SEVEN MILES BOOTS
- modified repeating texts during Kara sex scene

notes.title: Web of shadows - now available
notes.content:
Finally! We’re ready to present you our expansion to HOROS game, called WEB OF SHADOWS!

Embark on an epic adventure game fused with a visual novel and a dash of RPG elements. Immerse yourself in a captivating storyline featuring intriguing characters, engaging gameplay, and unique erotic encounters that will leave you breathless.

 introduction of 2 new characters – the Spider queen Silkara and the farm girl Rosie, together with new plotlines and endings
 inspiring new events with already established characters, full of new kinks and interesting background story
 highly improved animations (for new content), with double the amount of animation frames and more visual variety
 dozens of new enemies to defeat, including spiders, zombies, legendary creatures and even the Minotaur
 the new set of skills, weapons, armor and new types of items that influence the way you travel around the world
 improved quest system with the TIPS & TRICKS for players that need help
 refreshed game interface and dozens of other less significant fixes

We've fixed the following problem:

notes.title: Small fix - problem with Emil
notes.content:
We've fixed the following problem:

- with the old saves made before DLC, in some specific cases, it was impossible to meet Emil without playing the game from scratch. We've fixed that, and now you can meet Emil without the need to play the game from the beginning.

notes.title: We're building demo
notes.content:
Game development is going very well. Right now, I’ve got implemented the complete story I plan to release in the demo, and right now, I need to focus on the following:


 level progression
 items and managing inventory
 trading with NPC (weapons, armor, and consumables)
 expand the basic combat system we got so far
 game interface
 text verification


The demo allows us to travel around the first locations of our realm (Swingmore town, cornfields, Elven forest, and swamps). It will include interactions with characters, combat with enemies, and sex scenes with adorable ladies.
